title: Full Kummer root chart geometry
statement: For a finite SNC component family C on Y and I a finite subset, a TameRootExtensionChart is an affine etale chart of the exact stratum open, with branch parameters and an affine weakly etale refinement U. Define its actual full parameter-root tower, boundary base change, punctured tower and punctured base, and their canonical maps. For a prime p and boundary D, TameRootChartGeometry consists of compatible root characters, the full deck-group action rotating the actual roots, its restriction to the punctured tower, the actual pro-etale covering and the invertible torsor comparison (x,g) ↦ (x,gx), all over their specified bases Built from [def-sfb-full-parameter-root-tower], [def-sfb-profinite-coefficient-linearization], [def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary], [def-sfb-strict-local-kummer-tame-module], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site].
